name: software-factory
description: Subagents that take one work ticket to a reviewed pull request: verified spec, build, review before push, and a browser check for page changes.

interface.shortDescription: Work ticket to reviewed pull request
interface.longDescription: Writes a verified spec into a work ticket, builds it on a local branch, reviews the code, commits and PR text before anything is pushed, and checks page changes in a real browser. Merges only when you ask.
defaultPrompt: Run the factory on issue #42 and merge it if review passes
